time_contract: occurrence/effective time is distinct from publication time
publication time is distinct from retrieval time
unknown times remain unknown rather than receiving synthetic precision
timestamps are normalised to UTC while source-native values remain in lineage
bootstrap discovery is distinct from incremental current-change detection
source-native identity and record hashes survive payload and parser-version changes
lineage_contract: immediate provider and ultimate originating institution are separate
syndicated, translated and mirrored documents share an origin component when evidence supports it
source count never substitutes for independent corroboration
